about: Law Lens map from old ADU statute numbers to current ones. Every mapping comes from the organizers' Lane 2 data list (lanes/2-clear-it/data/DATA-SOURCES.md, checked by organizers 2026-11-06), which says it was confirmed on leginfo and in the HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026). Team 1 has NOT confirmed any entry yet: confirmed stays false and checked_date stays null until a person opens the source and checks it. Law Lens should show new_range as written; do not narrow a range to one section unless that entry is confirmed.
